title: Spain’s Protesters See ‘Madness’ of Rising Rent and a ‘Martyr’ in Maricarmen
summary_full: Thousands of protesters marched in Madrid on Thursday, a day after the death of María del Carmen Abascal, an 87-year-old whose eviction became a symbol of the country’s housing crisis.
